name: Troy Citadel Temple Hall
description: Low-poly Late Bronze Age megaron facing +Z: two-column porch, open 2.4 x 3.1 m doorway, four-column hall and central circular hearth, flat roof with smoke/light opening, rear offering dais and side benches. 2024 triangles, 12 mesh draws and four pack-derived materials. Limestone and plaster use smooth finishes from pinned masonry; crimson columns and wood retain pinned timber grain. Reviewed in material-faithful exterior, roof-off plan and interior cameras; standard exporter and editable delivery.
brief: Make a temple hall for Troy's citadel with a columned porch and an interior.
